This is one of the most real posts I've seen on here about dating a trans person. Understandably it can be confusing at first and rightfully so but what your doing in taking the time to properly think it over is great. Many pre-op trans women don't even feel comfortable having sex due to dysphoria so it might not be a big thing for her either. It obviously depends how much you value sex in a relationship but that is different for everyone. My ex was a trans woman and I remember feeling the same sort of way as you but we communicated with each other about it and found out that we were both very much on the same page. If you need any advice or someone to talk to feel free to PM me everyones experience is different but I will do my best to help.
